articles.title: How to start and keep your stock register
articles.summary: Type opening stock once in Nivesh Sahayak, let bills move stock, adjust damage or own use, count stock, set low-stock levels, and print the stock summary.

articles.title: Stock ledger, and fast and slow items
articles.card: Stock ledger and fast or slow items
articles.summary: Read the Nivesh Sahayak stock ledger for one item, a group, a godown or a batch, with in, out, balance and value, and find fast and slow moving items.
